_comment: Gate 3 coordinator freeze, written BEFORE the run per protocol section A.2. This run exists to answer one question the project has never answered: is there a healthy S03 -> S09 chain, and do bands 2-5 and the finale produce any evidence about their own content? Gate F run 3 (2026-08-27/28) could not -- its S06-S09 failures were one South Bridge stranding counted once per dependent assertion, and archive/reports/GATE_F_RUN_3_FINDINGS.md says so in its own words.
candidate_ref: claude/gate-3-coordinator-cjgwca (main at 3c73aab5 plus this branch's docs-only commits)

supersedes._comment: Nothing. This does NOT supersede ralph/reports/gate-f-candidate/RUN_METADATA.json, which remains the 2026-08-27 candidate record for that run. This file is scoped to this run directory only, which is why it lives here and not there.

logic._comment: This run is LOGIC ONLY, declared here before the run rather than chosen mid-run, which is what the harness's own _freeze_display_claim() comment demands after run 2. Every segment S01-S10e declares evidence_lane=logic already; their prescribed frames are DELEGATED to the *C capture lanes, which this run does not execute. The capture debt is therefore real and outstanding, not discharged -- read it with tools/gate_f/run_inventory.py.

suite_state_at_freeze._comment: NOT re-run before this freeze, and this field exists so nobody reads an implied green. The full unit suite is ~28 minutes and this container provisioned bare; asset import alone took ~50 minutes. docs/CURRENT_STATE.md section 2 records 1728 unit tests / 0 failures as of 2026-09-02 on main at cf535cce, which is three landings ago and is NOT a claim about this SHA.

known_open_defects_at_freeze: docs/CURRENT_STATE.md section 3, P1: the tutorial catch is unstable across KO/re-engage rounds. smoke_gate_b_continuous has failed inside the opening in two different ways on consecutive runs of one commit. If S03 fails this way it is this defect, not a new finding -- and it is the same mechanism that stranded run 3, so it is the single most likely thing to end this chain early.

docs/CURRENT_STATE.md section 3, P2: the gather-route walker cannot round the village_boundary concave corner past TrailGate. ralph/FENCE-CORNER-0903 fixed stick_navigator for this and is NOT on this SHA.

Six Gate 3 lanes are pushing branches concurrently. None of their work is on this SHA. This run measures main-as-of-3c73aab5, which is the baseline their changes will be judged against, not the post-Gate-3 state.
what_this_run_cannot_say: Anything about how the game LOOKS. No frames are rendered. Every visual verdict is delegated and outstanding.
Anything about ROG Ally frame rate, GPU frame time, VRAM or thermals -- [OWNER-ONLY], per section 0.4.
Anything about the Windows export's behaviour, per section 0.5.
